item.title: Editorial: Rx stimulant an illicit drug trade favorite
item.description: If a review of recent Lowell area drug arrests is any indication, one particular prescription stimulant has become traffickers’ illicit substance of choice. That would be Adderall; its popularity stems from its widespread availability, properties that enhance cognitive acuity, but also mirror illegal drugs like cocaine and methamphetamine.
